offering_erpModular.name: Modular ERP

offering_erpModular.description: Custom build or monthly SaaS subscription of "Modular ERP". Buy it as software (we hand over the code) or pay monthly while we host it for you.

basico.description: To validate the idea with a limited scope
basico.idealPara: Small teams getting started with accounting entries

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.idealPara: SMBs with steady flow and accounting entries

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.description: Multi-channel with high volume and personalization
avanzado.idealPara: Mid-market companies with high volumes of accounting entries
incluye: Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.idealPara: Enterprises with compliance and thousands of accounting entries
incluye: Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium
